name: GeoFWI3D_UNETR_XY_D4_augmentation_f0s0
objective: Test whether horizontal spatial augmentation improves generalization of fixed UNETR ViT-B/16 within the existing cap
hypothesis: Repeated exposure to 19 unaugmented volumes encourages memorization; horizontal symmetry augmentation may improve generalization. This mechanism is not established by the existing metrics.

frozen.loss: Foreground-only squared Dice + CE, weights 1:1, unchanged from rescue

only_change.augmentation: XY D4: four quarter-turn rotations, optionally composed with one horizontal reflection; uniform over eight group elements
only_change.rng: Dedicated stateless per-update RNG; do not alter model initialization or case order

initialization: Fresh seed-0 initialization matching archived controls; no reuse of retired checkpoint
comparison: Archived standard_lr rescue; do not retrain control

accounting.validation_and_diagnostic_costs: Separate from optimization cap; report explicitly
accounting.condition: Verify unchanged model/loss operation counts before launch; no arithmetic interpolation in transforms

futility_gate.metric: Mean unaugmented validation Dice at updates 165 and 207
futility_gate.otherwise: Archive as pruned at half budget; no automatic seed or recipe retries
futility_gate.rationale: Pragmatic compute triage, not a statistically established boundary; may reject a slower learner

success: Final-budget Dice strictly greater than 0.50; a peak alone is insufficient
followup: Only after passing, verify the fixed recipe on a second fold with the same seed before any broad seed search; predeclare seeds and retain failures
comparability: Separate augmented protocol. Existing no-augmentation results remain intact. If adopted for a matched four-model comparison, evaluate the common augmentation policy for all models.
